pattern: SELECT .+ FROM Ref_Template_Types JOIN \(\s*SELECT Template_Type_Code, COUNT\(*\) as total FROM Templates GROUP BY Template_Type_Code\) AS temp_count ON Ref_Template_Types.Template_Type_Code = temp_count.Template_Type_Code WHERE temp_count.total < \d+
correction: Use the HAVING clause to filter grouped results instead of joining with a subquery.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that unnecessarily join with a subquery, when the same result can be achieved using the GROUP BY and HAVING clauses.
